---
title: "sim-variants"
---

This command simulates DNA and RNA variants (simultaneously).

<div style="background-color:#f8f8f8; padding:12px; font-family: monospace, monospace;">
<pre>
usage: exacto sim-variants [-h] 
</pre>
</div>

### Output TSV File

<div class="table">

| Header                               | Description                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| sample_id                            | Sample ID                                                                                                 |
| variant_id                           | Variant ID                                                                                                |
| chr_1                                | Chromosome 1                                                                                              |
| pos_1                                | Position 1                                                                                                |
| chr_2                                | Chromosome 2                                                                                              |
| pos_2                                | Position 2                                                                                                |

: {tbl-colwidths="[30,55,15]"}

</div>
